NONE: › to make someone or yourself familiar with something
使認識；使了解；使熟悉；使知悉

example: Take time to acquaint yourself with the rules.
花點時間熟悉一下規則。
The Broadcasting Museum offers workshops to acquaint children with the world of radio.
廣播博物館還舉辦講習班讓孩子了解無線電世界。

C: C1 [ C ] a person that you have met but do not know well
相識的人，熟人；泛泛之交
U: › [ U ] formal used in some expressions about knowing or meeting people
（用在某些表達方式中表示）認識，結識
› [ U ] formal knowledge of a subject

example: a business acquaintance
在生意上打過交道的人
It was at the Taylors' party that I first made his acquaintance (= first met him).
我是在泰勒家的聚會上初次和他相識的。
I wasn't sure about Darryl when I first met her, but on further acquaintance (= knowing her a little more) I rather like her.
第一次遇到達裡爾時，我不確定自己對她的觀感，但是隨著進一步的了解，我很喜歡她。
Sadly, my acquaintance with Spanish literature is rather limited.
可惜，我對西班牙文學所知相當有限。

after verb: › [ after verb ] knowing or being familiar with a person
› to know or be familiar with something, because you have studied it or have experienced it before

example: "Do you know Daphne?" "No, I'm afraid we're not acquainted."
「你認識達夫妮嗎？」「很遺憾，我跟她不認識。」
I am not personally acquainted with the gentleman in question.
我本人和所說的這位先生並不相識。
Police said the thieves were obviously well acquainted with the alarm system at the department store.
警方稱，盜賊顯然對百貨公司的警報系統瞭如指掌。

NONE: › to accept or agree to something, often unwillingly
默認；默許；默然同意

example: Reluctantly, he acquiesced to/in the plans.
雖然很不情願，他還是默許了這個計劃。

NONE: › willing to do what other people want
默認的；默許的；默從的

example: She has a very acquiescent nature.
她生性逆來順受。

NONE: B2 to get something
取得，獲得；購得；學到

example: I was wearing a newly/recently acquired jacket.
我穿著一件新買的夾克衫。
I seem to have acquired (= have got although I don't know how) two copies of this book.
這本書我好像重複買了。
He has acquired a reputation for being difficult to work with.
據說很難跟他共事。

NONE: › a lack of gamma globulins (= a type of protein that gives protection against diseases) in the blood
獲得性無丙球蛋白血症，獲得性丙球蛋白缺乏血症
› a company that buys other companies, usually to sell them for a profit
（通常指為了獲利而買賣其他公司的）收購公司

example: A business with so much growth is sure to generate interest among potential acquirers.
發展如此迅速的企業必然會引起各收購公司的潛在興趣。

NONE: › US →
acquirer

U: › [ U ] the process of getting something

C: › [ C ] something that someone buys, often to add to a collection of things

C or U: › [ C or U ] something such as a building, another company, or a piece of land that is bought by a company, or the act of buying it
收購物（房屋、公司、土地等）；收購

example: The acquisition of huge amounts of data has helped our research enormously.
獲得的大量數據對我們的研究有莫大的幫助。
Language acquisition (= learning a language without being taught) starts at a very young age.
語言習得始於幼年。
The museum's latest acquisition is a four-million-dollar sculpture.
該博物館最新購置的藏品為一尊價值400萬美元的雕塑。
I like your earrings - are they a recent acquisition? (= Did you get them recently?)
我挺喜歡你的耳環——你剛買的嗎？

NONE: › often disapproving eager to own and collect things
（對財物）渴望得到的，迫切求取的；貪婪的
› business used to describe a company that buys other companies
收購的

example: We live in an acquisitive society that views success primarily in terms of material possessions.
我們生活在一個貪求功利的社會中，判斷一個人成功與否首要是看他擁有多少物質財富。
It has been one of the most acquisitive firms in recent times, buying over a dozen businesses in the last 18 months.
該公司是近年來收購行為最為頻繁的公司之一，在過去18個月內收購了十幾家公司。

NONE: › often disapproving eagerness to own and collect things
（對財物）渴望得到，迫切求取；貪婪
› specialized business the fact that a company buys other companies
收購行為

example: He was known for his acquisitiveness, buying any work of art that caught his eye.
他因為頻頻收購而聞名，所有引起他興趣的藝術品都被其購入囊中。
The group's acquisitiveness seems to be holding down its stock price.
該集團的收購行為似乎使其股價低迷。

T often passive: › [ T often passive ] to decide officially in a law court that someone is not guilty of a particular crime

NONE: › to do better than expected in a difficult situation
（在困難的情況下）表現出色

example: She was acquitted of all the charges against her.
她被宣判無罪，所有對其指控皆不成立。
Five months ago he was acquitted on a shoplifting charge.
五個月前，法庭宣判對他在商店盜竊貨物的指控不成立。

convict verb

我認為他在今天會議上的表現非常不錯。

NONE: › the decision of a court that someone is not guilty
宣判無罪

example: The first trial ended in a hung jury, the second in acquittal.
第一次審判因為陪審團意見不一致而未能作出裁定，第二次審判以宣判無罪告終。
Of the three cases that went to trial, two ended in acquittals.
付諸庭審的三個案件中，有兩個最終作出無罪判決。
